# ISAC Systems

> Official website: https://isacsystem.si/

ISAC Systems (also referred to as ISACSystem) is a capability intelligence ecosystem developed by Master Research & Development Institute (MRDI) in Surat, Gujarat, India. It supports engineering education through structured cohort learning and practical capability profiles.

## Official pages

- [ISAC Systems home](https://isacsystem.si/): Official overview of the ISAC ecosystem.
- [ISAC.SI](https://isacsystem.si/isac-si-tech.html): MRDI's structured learning management platform for engineering education cohorts, practical assignments, tutors, and program teams.
- [ISAC.XP](https://isacsystem.si/isac-xp.html): A capability profile that helps learners make projects, practical skills, and experience visible through the Learning Capability Index (LCI).
- [Enquiries](https://isacsystem.si/enquiry.html): Contact MRDI about ISAC access, profiles, and engineering programs.
- [Feedback](https://isacsystem.si/feedback.html): Learner and employer perspectives on ISAC Systems.
